Package org.apache.cayenne.map

Class SelectQueryDescriptor

java.lang.Object
org.apache.cayenne.map.QueryDescriptor
org.apache.cayenne.map.SelectQueryDescriptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProjectNode, XMLSerializable
public class SelectQueryDescriptor extends QueryDescriptor
A mapped select query, defined by a String in the syntax of ObjectSelect.parse(String, Object...). The root of the query is defined by its "from" clause, so it is null while the String can't be parsed. The settings that the String has no syntax for (caching, page size, etc.) are the properties of the descriptor.
Since:
4.0
